PROPERTY CATASTROPHE EXCESS OF LOSS REINSURANCE TREATY
Cedent: Meridian Insurance Group, Inc.
Reinsurer: Northbridge Reinsurance Company Ltd.
Broker: Aon Benfield Re Solutions
Treaty Type: Property Catastrophe Excess of Loss
Treaty Reference: MIG-NRC-2026-CAT-01
Period of Cover: 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026, both days inclusive
Territory: United States of America and Puerto Rico
Currency: United States Dollars (USD)
Lines of Business: Commercial Property, Homeowners, Inland Marine

FINANCIAL TERMS
Layer 1:
  Attachment Point: 10,000,000
  Limit: 20,000,000
  Reinsurance Premium: 1,800,000
  Reinstatements: 2 at 100% pro rata additional premium
Layer 2:
  Attachment Point: 30,000,000
  Limit: 40,000,000
  Reinsurance Premium: 950,000
  Reinstatements: 1 at 100% pro rata additional premium
Brokerage: 10% of gross reinsurance premium
Profit Commission: Not applicable
Payment Terms: Quarterly in advance, net 30 days

EXCLUSIONS
This Treaty excludes losses directly or indirectly arising from:
1. War, invasion, act of foreign enemy, hostilities or warlike operations
2. Nuclear reaction, nuclear radiation, or radioactive contamination
3. Terrorism, as defined under the Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA)
4. Pollution and environmental contamination, seepage or contamination
5. Asbestos-related bodily injury or property damage claims
6. Cyber-attack, data breach, or loss of electronic data
7. Communicable disease, pandemic, or epidemic-related business interruption
8. Losses sustained prior to the inception date of this Treaty
9. Fraudulent or dishonest acts of the Cedent’s employees
10. Currency fluctuation and cryptocurrency-denominated losses

CLAIMS, REPORTING & DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Notice of Loss: The Cedent shall notify the Reinsurer within 30 days of
becoming aware of any loss reasonably likely to involve this Treaty.
Claims Payment Currency: All claims shall be settled in United States Dollars,
regardless of the currency in which the underlying policy was written.
Loss Reserves: The Cedent shall report loss reserves quarterly, itemized by
occurrence and layer.
Arbitration: Any dispute arising under this Treaty shall be settled by
arbitration in New York, New York, under the rules of the American
Arbitration Association. Each party shall appoint one arbitrator, and the
two arbitrators shall jointly appoint a third.
Governing Law: This Treaty shall be governed by the laws of the State of
New York, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles.
